title.zh: 将巴伦苏埃拉市 Malinta 描笼涯的 Malinta 小学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Pinalagad 小学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Malinta Elementary School – Pinalagad Annex in Sitio Pinalagad, Barangay Malinta, Valenzuela City, Metro Manila From the Malinta Elementary School, Converting It Into An Independent Elementary School to Be Known as Pinalagad Elementary School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Malinta Elementary School – Pinalagad Annex in Sitio Pinalagad, Barangay Malinta, Valenzuela City, Metro Manila From the Malinta Elementary School, Converting It Into An Independent Elementary School to Be Known as Pinalagad Elementary School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Pinalagad của Trường Tiểu học Malinta tại Barangay Malinta, Thành phố Valenzuela, Vùng Metro Manila khỏi Trường Tiểu học Malinta và chuyển thành Trường Tiểu học Độc lập với tên gọi Trường Tiểu học Pinalagad, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Pinalagad ของโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Malinta ในบารังไกย์ Malinta เมือง Valenzuela เขตมหานครมะนิลาออกจากโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Malinta และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษาเอกเทศชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Pinalagad และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Pinalagad, Sekolah Dasar Malinta di Barangay Malinta, Kota Valenzuela, Wilayah Metropolitan Manila dari Sekolah Dasar Malinta dan menjadi Sekolah Dasar Mandiri dengan nama Sekolah Dasar Pinalagad, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Pinalagad, Sekolah Rendah Malinta di Barangay Malinta, Bandar Valenzuela, Wilayah Metropolitan Manila daripada Sekolah Rendah Malinta dan menjadi Sekolah Rendah Bebas dengan nama Sekolah Rendah Pinalagad, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Malinta Elementary School-Pinalagad Annex in Sitio Pinalagad, Barangay Malinta, Valenzuela City, Metro Manila is hereby separated from the Malinta Elementary School and converted into an independent elementary school to be known as Pinalagad Elementary School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Malinta Elementary School-Pinalagad Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Pinalagad Elementary School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Pinalagad Elementary School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Malinta Elementary School-Pinalagad Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within sixty (60) days after the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate and issue the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
